runtime: vLLM 0.8.5 V0, unchanged existing Nano8B weights; source-matched NVIDIA nonstreaming parser
parser_license: Apache-2.0; model weights have their separate model license.

source_search.license: MIT; underlying source/data conditions remain separate.
source_search.provider: PubMed only; OLS4 disabled; no paid API dependency.

abstract_inspection: Existing exact-PMID PubMed XML fetch/parser, no PMC/fulltext expansion.

native_nonparallel_policy.behavior: Select provider-parsed entry0 only when parallel_tool_calls=False; never scan later entries.
native_nonparallel_policy.suppressed_entries: Count only; no arguments/content/history/source execution/final handoff retained.

native_api_policy.choice_steps: auto with the qualified first-provider-parsed-entry return policy
native_api_policy.finish_only_steps: Standard named function tool_choice finish; explicit guided_decoding_backend=outlines.
native_api_policy.named_finish_response: Exactly one wrapped finish call, finish_reason=stop, full deterministic argument/ID/usage/cap guards.
native_api_policy.auto_response: finish_reason=tool_calls; stop is not a successful auto handoff.
native_api_policy.tokenization: Same exact tools through chat_template_kwargs and native history; tool_choice does not alter the pinned renderer.
native_api_policy.named_finish_rationale: Matches the retained JSON controller forced-finish catalogue; no free-text or new action budget.

privacy: Raw model bodies/non-tool assistant content/reasoning are discarded; accepted actions and source provenance are retained privately.

data_reference.name: BioASQ 11 original public training questions
data_reference.scope: 12 factoid+12 list; same questions/reference lists already exposed during earlier development; not a fresh holdout.

source_scope: Candidate paper discovery/inspection; not claim entailment, independent Pharos evidence or biological graph accuracy.
